name: heading
label: Heading
hint: Defaults to "Asset Tag Station" when empty

name: subtitle
label: Subtitle
hint: Defaults to "Scan a serial number to review the asset, update it, and print a tag." when empty

name: organization_name
label: Organization name on tag
hint: Overrides the x_1026751_itsm_ins.asset_tag.organization_name property. When both are empty, the asset's company is printed

name: tag_width_in
label: Tag width (inches)
hint: Printed label width in inches, to match your label stock

name: tag_height_in
label: Tag height (inches)
hint: Printed label height in inches, to match your label stock

name: contact_phone
label: Contact phone on tag
hint: Printed as "If found, please contact ..." Overrides the x_1026751_itsm_ins.asset_tag.contact_phone property; the line is left off when both are empty
